### In Every Change, God Stays the Same
Author: Seth Porch
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/in-every-change-god-stays-the-same
Passage: Psalm 102:11-12
Points:
- Humans naturally long for permanence, yet human life is brief and fleeting like an evening shadow.
- Seeking relief merely through changing life circumstances offers only temporary respite, not true stability.
- Amid affliction and loneliness, the psalmist anchors his soul in God's eternal, unchanging throne.
- Because God has no beginning or end, His character, goodness, and steadfast love never waver.
- Believers can find unshakable refuge by resting upon the Lord as their immovable Rock.

### God Unchanging
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-unchanging-3
Passage: Psalm 102:15-28
Points:
- People often search for security in human relationships, wealth, or governments that inevitably fail.
- Creation itself—even the heavens and earth—is subject to wear and decay like an old garment.
- In trials and distress, the psalmist finds confidence through a sound understanding of God's unchanging nature.
- Because God never changes, His covenant promises to show compassion and redeem His people cannot fail.
- True and lasting safety is found only in the Creator, who remains completely dependable forever.
